description: Launch a saved Scenario as a Load Test, exactly as stored. Its Populations send real traffic to the user's site. Like the Dashboard's Launch button, it runs on the account's plan when get_scenario shows no Fuel estimate and runs the whole test on Fuel when it shows one. Read the Scenario with get_scenario first, tell the user the Fuel estimate range and the fuelBalance, or that the plan covers it when there is no estimate, and launch only with the user's approval. If the plan can't run the test right now, the refusal gives the reason and burns no Fuel, and the user can try to launch from the Dashboard instead. If the call times out, check list_load_tests before launching again. A Scenario with launchBlockers is refused, and the refusal lists them. Trial, plan, Fuel and other checks apply as in the Dashboard, and a refusal carries their message. The result carries the new Load Test's id, its stage and the Dashboard link; follow it with get_load_test_status and stop it with stop_load_test.

label.description: A label stored with the Load Test. Leave it out for none.
